name: SikaFiber PPM 48/19
paste:
SIKAFIBER® PPM 48/19: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19, October 2024, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikafiber_ppm_4819.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2024, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is a blend of Macro Structural Synthetic Fibres and Micro Monofilament Fibres which are designed to an optimum gradation. This engineered combination of macro/micro fibres provides improved interfacial bonding and flexural toughness efficiency.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Fibrecrete/shotcrete
    - Ground supported slabs
    - External pavements
    - Nonmagnetic applications
    - Composite metal decks
    - Roads
    - Precast
    - Sea defence
    - Control and reduce plastic shrinkage cracking
    - Sprayed concrete
    - Slope stabilization
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Blended Polyolefin Macro/Micro – synthetic fibres designed to enhance the distribution and performance of fibre reinforcement
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Macro fibre complies with EN 14489-2 Class 2 and micro with Class 1a. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 meets the requirements of ASTM C1116 Type III.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 14489-2: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - ASTM C1116: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Non magnetic
    - Rustproof
    - Requires no minimum amount of concrete cover
    - It is always placed in compliance with the codes
    - Durability is enhanced
    - Safer and easier than traditional reinforcement
    - Environmentally friendly recycled packaging
    - SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 concrete can be pumped, sprayed or placed using conventional equipment.
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Recommended dosage: The typical dose rate for SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is 2.3 kg per m³. Higher dose rates up 6.9 kg per m³ can be used as the performance requirements dictate.
    - Compatibility: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is compatible with all Sika Concrete admixtures and additives.
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: N/A
    - Storage conditions: Store protected from the weather.
2.7 Packaging. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 is packed in 2.3kg boxes consisting of 2kg of macro fibre component and a biodegradable bag with 0.3kg of micro fibre. Each box is designed for fast dispersion within the concrete mix. SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 can be packed on pallets or most other combinations if required.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2024, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2024, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Limitations and important considerations. The addition of SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 can cause a reduction in the concrete consistence. We recommend correcting this loss not by adding more water, but by adjusting the mix to the required consistence with a suitable dosage of Sika® ViscoCrete® or SikaPlast® (water reducers).
4.3 Further documentation - Technical information.
    | Fibre type | Macro fibre | Micro fibre |
    | Material | 100% Polyolefin polymer | Virgin Polypropylene |
    | Melt point | 170° C | 150°-170° C |
    | Specific Gravity | 0.92 g/cm³ | 0.91 g/cm³ |
    | Tensile strength | 550+ MPa | 450 MPa |
    | Alkali resistance | Excellent | Excellent |
    | Fibre Type | Embossed | Mono filament |
    | Electrical conductivity | Low | Low |
    | Moisture content | 0 % | 0% |
    | Fibre length | 48 mm | 18 mm |
    | Mean thickness | 0.34 mm | N/A |
    | Mean width | 1.37 mm | N/A |
    | Average diameter | NA | 35 μm ± 5 |
    | Absorption | Nil | Nil |
    | Fibres per kg SikaFiber® PPM 48/19 reinforced concrete can be finished by any finishing technique. | 32000±3% | N/A |

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2024, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaFiber® PPM 48/19, October 2024, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikafiber_ppm_4819.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Polypropylene-based macro and blended fibres, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/epd-polypropylene-basedmacroandblendedfibres.pdf
    - Brochure: Sika Fibre Solutions 2026 v1, version 05/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/Sika%20Fibre%20-%20A4%202025%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
